description.value: SUD SOI brings the regional cuisines of Issan and Lanna — Northeastern and Northern Thailand — to Vancouver's Commercial Drive, inside the Il Mercato building. The name means 'the very end of the lane' in Thai, and the 52-seat dining room reflects that neighbourhood warmth with pastel greens, natural wood tones, and design inspired by Thai regional culture. Signature dishes include Kao Soi (Northern Thai coconut curry noodle soup), Som Tum (green papaya salad), and Midnight Sticky Rice & Chicken.
